assertions.reason: User API/UX gating and admin-positive paths matched contract: user /api/admin/permissions=403 (Admin access required), workspace-admin=200, superadmin=200 isSuperAdmin=true; stale invalid adminRoleIds test also returned 403; UI showed no Admin Console for user, Admin Console visible for workspace/superadmin, and /admin redirected user back to /c/new.

Lower-tier scope matrix matched expected permissions: workspace-admin had users/usage/settings read+write and observability (200), support-admin had users/usage/settings read only (200 with 403 on settings write, observability, delete), observability-admin had observability only (200 with 403 on users/usage/settings); /api/admin/rbac/roles and PATCH role/adminRoleIds were 403 for non-superadmins and 200 for superadmin.

Auto-promotion did not occur on auth flow in direct demotion/relogin test: superadmin demote PATCH succeeded (role->USER), subsequent login returned role USER, and /api/admin/permissions returned 403 instead of isSuperAdmin=true.

Settings persisted and observability links were host-aware: after storing localhost-style observability URLs, GET /api/admin/settings with forwarded host/proto rewrote links to https://dev-rbac.example.test:<port>; baseline settings were restored successfully.

Provider settings cog behavior matched role rules: superadmin model selector showed provider 'Set API Key' buttons, while workspace-admin and normal user selectors showed no provider settings buttons; My Agents row had no settings button.

Reopening provider settings preserved saved-state indicators: xAI SetKey dialog showed password field plus Revoke indicator on first open and again after close/reopen, confirming saved configuration is preloaded/recognized across reopen.
Deletion boundary checks matched contract with workspace-admin token: DELETE self=400, DELETE superadmin target=403, DELETE standard user=200.

frictions.description: Auth limiter/temporary-ban protections trigger quickly when switching many personas; repeated UI/API login attempts required reseed + dev API restart to continue deterministic validation.
frictions.resolution: Applied mandated bootstrap recovery (dev-seed-validation-personas.js + docker restart librechat-dev-api + wait ~20s) between high-login phases.
